notes.title: Oct 24th Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi,
We are Leaf Boat Studio. 
After two weeks of testing, we can make sure the loading problem in Tower mode has been fixed now. Then we will start to make plan about next version, thanks for every suggestions for you. If you meet any problems again, please report back to us through the Steam community. Thank you.

notes.notes:

notes.notes:

We are Leaf Boat Studio. This patch fixes the very serious problem of getting a black screen when you login again after changing the resolution. We are incredibly sorry for creating such a bad gaming. Mid-Autumn Festival is this Friday. We want to wish everyone a Happy Mid-Autumn Festival!

Patch notes:
-	Fixed the problem of getting a black screen when you login again after changing the resolution.
-	Fixed the problem of the Tower mode shop being able to buy multiple copies of a card.

There should be more than enough cards to build a battle deck. There’s no time to wait. Take your deck into battle now!

notes.title: Steam Early Access version in now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35130372/213ed7d9c2a872b35c9f677ce3ff9f72ecf68a18.png[/img]
Hi,
We are Leaf Boat Studio. Our studio’s first game Born of Fire is now in Steam Early Access! 

First, we want to thank every enthusiastic player that gave their valuable opinions. This does indeed still have many shortcomings, but we want to tell everyone the game is a lot of fun. Perhaps by looking at a picture of the game, it seems to have traces of other games. Please patiently download the game, and then play it for 10 minutes. You will be surprised to find this game is quite different. Anyway, it won’t cost you anything, will it?

I really like Hearthstone. I really like Slay the Spire too. I don’t know if everyone is like me and thought, “What would it be like if a Roguelike could also be Battle game?” That is how this game was conceived. Also, its growth and path of change will be very long. On this path, it can’t be without your support and suggestions. I hope everyone can help us to make this game better and better.

To celebrate the Early Access release, we have prepared a special gift for every player who plays this version. Please smash the mail button in the upper right-hand corner to claim lots of cards! There should be more than enough cards to build a battle deck. There’s no time to wait. Take your deck into battle now!

notes.title: Born of Fire Free Trial Version Is Available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35130372/99d055068e9d2c7c36a642111838da4e79dbeb6d.png[/img]
Hi,
We are Leaf Boat Studio. We are excited to announce that our first game Born of Fire’s free trial version is now available!

Born of Fire fuses the gameplay of Roguelike and deck-building games. In the trial version, you can play a basic version of the tower mode. When you clear a floor, you can choose a card to “take with you” and place it in your deck. Also, you will get chests. When you open the chests, you will get completely new cards.

You can build a deck from the cards you collect and then you can battle other players! You will get chests if you win or lose to get even more cards. When you get multiples of a card, it will transform into experience to upgrade the card’s level and make the card even stronger. Then when you get this card again in tower mode, it will be at its upgraded level. Your journey through the tower will be smoother by continuing to upgrade cards.

You can experience everything described above in the free trial version. In the next few weeks, we plan to add even more content:

General:
+ Support Traditional and Simplified Chinese
+ Add 5 songs
+ Support on/off switch for music and sound

Tower Mode:
+ Shop
+ Campsite
+ Artifacts
+ Add more Roguelike events to include exclusive events for heroes and creatures.
+ Add more creature AI and spells
+ Adjust the balance weekly

Cards:
+ Add a new card every week including creatures and spells
+ Adjust card balance weekly

We plan to release the early access version in the not to distance future to add even more content: 
+ Completely new heroes for commander class and mage class
+ Mission system
+ Achievement system
+ Double-headed giant (2 vs 2)
+ Story mode
+ Daily and weekly tasks
+ More cards, creatures, and artifacts
+ Support more languages

Now please play the free trial version of Born of Fire. We are looking forward to hearing your feedback and suggestions, which will help us to improve the game.
